An effectively delivered zinger is a potent tool. It can instantly defuse an awkward, overly-signaling situation. Who does not feel relaxed after an office jester makes fun of their mistake? In a meeting with a group that’s approaching my territory, I once used humor to let the group know that I intended to be “administering policy” rather than in a “selling” role. And when I first heard about a key hire that wasn't gender diverse, I asked my immediate boss what was going on. He said, “You’ll like him.” Without even a moment to breathe I had responded: “You know me too well,” an awkward moment avoided.
